## DeepSeek Harness 0.1.1

Tracks the DeepSeek Harness release train: bundles `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-alpha.2** (previously 0.1.0-rc.6).

- Adapts the shell to the 0.1.5-alpha Host: carries the per-process access token from the readiness URL into the window (first navigation only) and spawns the Host with `--no-open`.
- Aligns the session header and the details header rows with the sidebar under the traffic-light inset.

- Upstream release: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/dsh-v0.1.5-alpha.2
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh/v/0.1.5-alpha.2

Signed and notarized automatically; existing installs update in the background.
